definitions.time: env_step zero-based; match 1 starts env0, match2 env101, match3 env202. First score denotes transition env_step. Discovery denotes pre-action decision env_step.
definitions.point_coordinates: canonical x,y; player1 maps world to (23-y,23-x)

limitations: Only the evaluated side has instrumented agent-visible knowledge/energy/context. Direct games record V14 actions and aggregate points, but no V14 belief/context.

Occupancy counts distinct currently KNOWN canonical point coordinates occupied by own units with nonnegative energy before action; not true hidden scoring tiles or exact score contributions. It is descriptive and time-shifted from transition scoring.

Active-to-absent events exclude match resets. They do not identify exact death cause and can miss same-ID death/respawn in one transition; spawn-jump candidates listed separately. No cross-ID lifetime, kill count, or energy-delta reward is inferred.
Overrides identify a final action direction different from masked net argmax, not a particular rule; SAP target-component changes are captured in full actions but not the direction override count.
First action divergence is verified on shared features when available; later score differences do not prove this action caused the outcome. State trajectories and opponents adapt.
Terminal match points are external evaluation measurements, never decision inputs; discovery and energy summaries use only captured agent-visible observations/context.
These are targeted known development cases; not a fresh win-rate sample or an independently randomized causal experiment.
